title: Preconditions for Drop Instructions
statement: For every mode, input bit string $h$, and configuration $c$ of the specified nine-register computation, the following instruction-dependent conditions hold: if the active instruction compares two registers, their indices are distinct; if it compares a register’s binary representation with the payload of a plain encoded pair, the input has that plain-pair form with a canonical payload; if it compares against either component of a nested encoded pair, the input has that nested-pair form with both payloads canonical; and if it calls an oracle using a list of registers, the list has no repetitions.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the nine-register computation
